title: DsConfig
description: The systems registry (ds.config.json). Maps a system id to its configuration.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file, for editor validation.

systems.description: One system = one consumable kit. A design system with a React kit and a web-component kit declares two systems.

SystemConfig.title: SystemConfig
SystemConfig.description: One system = one consumable kit. Every tool takes a `system` argument, optional when only one is configured.

name.description: Human name shown to agents, e.g. "Acme Elements". Defaults to the id.

root.description: Checkout root the adapters read from. Relative paths resolve against the config file's directory.

rootEnv.description: Env var that overrides `root` (a CI checkout, a teammate's path).

dataDir.description: Where generated ground truth lives. Default: data/<id>. Committed on purpose.

componentModel.description: 'react' (default): components are imported by name. 'custom-elements': registered once, written as dashed tags.

componentsPkg.description: The specifier consumers import (react) or register (custom-elements), e.g. "@acme/react".

docs.description: Markdown docs to index, globs relative to root.

aliases.description: Team-maintained alias file, relative to the config dir. Default: <dataDir>/aliases.json if present.

CatalogSource.title: CatalogSource
CatalogSource.description: Where the catalog comes from. Adapters are the only place format knowledge lives.

oneOf.description: An already-built catalog in this repo's SystemCatalog shape (or the bench's). Path relative to root.
A custom-elements.json (Custom Elements Manifest, schema 1.x or 2.x). Path relative to root.
Reserved for react-docgen-typescript extraction from a source tree. Not implemented in P0: the adapter returns a clear error.
CSS files declaring custom properties, e.g. compiled tokens.css. Paths relative to root.
Design Tokens Community Group JSON (DTCG) files. Paths relative to root.
